messages:
emma_cs: Quick heads-up — I'm aggregating feedback from 3 pilots (Helix, ParkCo, NorthBay). Seeing recurring onboarding friction + a few feature asks that could impact renewal risk. Posting a short summary so product can react before next week

jordan_pm: thanks emma. can you list top pain points + rough customer impact? prioritization will depend on scope/cost.

emma_cs: sure. high-level: 1) confusingsetup for per-route billing toggles — customers think it's global. causes billing disputes and delays to go-live. 2) lack of token-level cost visibility in the onboarding checklist — finance teams ask for per-route estimates. 3) webhook retry/backoff behavior during our dedicated onboarding VPCs — ParkCo lost events during a migration window.

maria_support: adding: Helix reported the embeddings latency spike when they pass large documents — they ask for an out-of-the-box chunking suggestion or a batching guide.

nate_success: can we group these into product/ops/enablement? I'll help create a quick playbook for CSMs to avoid renewal churn while product fixes things. :muscle:

jordan_pm: useful. my quick take: (A) billing toggle UI/UX — product-led fix, medium effort, high impact on conversions. (B) token visibility in onboarding export — could be small analytics/console change, medium impact. (C) webhook retry/backoff — infra+runtime, high effort but high-severity for a few accounts.

rajesh_se: pinging infra team re: webhook backoff. quick log snippet from ParkCo incident: ```ERROR 2025-08-05T14:22:31Z delivery failed status=502 attempts=3 route=parkco-webhook``` They had custom proxy that dropped `Retry-After`. We can add a configurable backoff policy by account.

emma_cs: thanks. feature asks customers explicitly requested: - per-route preview of monthly cost - toggle-level tooltip explaining scope (org vs route) - onboarding checklist export with estimated tokens/sample costs - an automated chunking suggestion for large docs (Helix)

jordan_pm: agree with ask list. for prioritization matrix we need: estimated engineering weeks, legal/security review (for billing previews), and CSM mitigation steps. Can you score each ask 1-5 for impact and frequency?

emma_cs: will do. quick scores from pilots: billing toggle confusion impact=4 freq=3, token visibility impact=3 freq=4, webhook retry impact=5 freq=1, chunking suggestion impact=3 freq=2.

maria_support: CSM mitigation notes: temporary tooltip + inline docs can reduce confusion fast. For webhook, recommend an interim SRE runbook and monitoring alert that tags affected accounts.

opsbot: Reminder: weekly product-ops sync on Thu 16:00. Attached template: https://docs.internal/redwood/cs/pilot-feedback-template

jordan_pm: next steps: emma/nate create a single spreadsheet with ask, pilot evidence, impact/frequency score, and suggested mitigation. I'll slot top-2 into roadmap discussion for Friday. If anyone can add brief customer quotes that'd help (one-liners).

emma_cs: will send spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow with quotes from Helix and ParkCo. thanks team! :pray:
